title: One import, three ways in
description: The command line, the GUI and the library all run the same importer: Morrowind.ini and an optional openmw.cfg in, an openmw.cfg out.

nodes.title: Morrowind.ini
nodes.detail: The load order, the archives, the weather, the fonts: the settings Morrowind.exe reads at startup.

nodes.title: dream-ini
nodes.detail: Finds every archive and content file in your Data Files, orders the content as Morrowind.exe does, and rewrites only the keys it imports.

nodes.title: openmw.cfg
nodes.detail: content=, fallback-archive=, fallback= and data= lines, written into your existing cfg with its comments kept.

nodes.title: Your openmw.cfg
nodes.detail: Optional. Read first; everything dream-ini does not import stays as it was.

nodes.title: CLI, GUI, library
nodes.detail: A command line, a desktop and handheld GUI, and the importer as a Rust crate and a Luau module.
